lines.text: The LORD tells Moses to send away anyone with a skin disease, a bodily discharge, or dead-body defilement.
The Israelites send them outside the camp so they will not defile the camp where the LORD dwells.
A guilty person who sins against another must confess, then repay in full and add a third of its value.
With no relative to receive it, the restitution belongs to the LORD and goes to the judge with a ram.
Every sacred contribution the Israelites bring to the priest belongs to him, while each man's sacred gifts stay his own.
